title: Facade Pattern
description: Provide a simplified interface to complex subsystems.

data.text:
**Facade Pattern**

Provides a unified interface to a set of interfaces in a subsystem. Facade defines a higher-level interface that makes the subsystem easier to use.

items: Creating a simple API for complex code

data.title: Facade in C#
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Facade is one of the most commonly used patterns in real applications.
